sk-component.button.intro: severity defines the button's color. Alongside the built-in severities, every Tailwind color family (including the custom mauve · olive · mist · taupe added in v4.2) can be used directly as a severity — e.g. <Button severity="indigo" label="Save" />. Works with all of the filled, outlined, text, raised, rounded and icon-only variants.
Built-in severities keep their PrimeVue styling — filled, outlined and text.

sk-component.message.intro: severity defines the message's color. Alongside the built-in severities, every Tailwind color family (including the custom mauve · olive · mist · taupe) can be used directly as a severity — e.g. <Message severity="indigo">. The default banner is the calm accent style; add class="p-message-fill" for the solid filled look, or the built-in variant="outlined" / "simple".
